content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can deploy a live store that accepts crypto payments from anywhere in the world. Start with GitHub Pages for hosting—it’s free and globally distributed. Use Google Apps Script for backend logic to handle orders and deliver products. For payments, integrate NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Load your first three products—ebooks, templates, or courses—and set prices in stablecoins like USDT or USDC. Test the entire flow: payment, order confirmation, and file delivery. By tonight, you’ll have a functional store that bypasses Stripe and PayPal entirely. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. Your customers pay directly from their wallets, and you receive funds instantly. No intermediaries. No geographic barriers. This is commerce infrastructure you control.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The stack is simple: GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments. This combination is free to deploy and requires no server management. GitHub Pages ensures your store is always online, while Google Apps Script automates order processing and product delivery. Google Sheets logs every transaction, giving you full visibility without third-party dashboards. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and triggers delivery instantly. This stack is lightweight, fast, and immune to regional restrictions. It’s designed for creators in Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, and beyond—places where traditional platforms fail. You don’t need to understand every detail to deploy it. Follow the blueprint, and you’ll have a working store in hours.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what’s critical: accepting payments and delivering products. Skip custom domains, advanced analytics, and email marketing integrations—these can come later. Right now, your goal is to get your first transaction live. Use the default GitHub Pages URL for your store. Track orders manually in Google Sheets instead of setting up automated reports. Deliver files via direct Google Drive links instead of building a download portal. NOWPayments handles payment verification, so you don’t need to write custom webhook logic. This minimalist approach ensures speed. Once your store is live and generating revenue, you can add features. But for now, simplicity is your ally. Deploy the essentials, test them, and start selling.
Deploy your store today—no servers, no Stripe, no geographic restrictions.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, start by setting up a NOWPayments account. Choose a stablecoin like USDT on the BSC network for low fees. Integrate the payment widget into your GitHub Pages store using the provided code snippet. Test the payment flow with a small transaction—send USDT from your wallet to your store. Once the payment confirms, Google Apps Script should log the order in Google Sheets and send the customer a download link from Google Drive. If it works, your store is live. Share the link with your audience and start accepting payments. This process takes less than an hour. You don’t need to wait for approval from Stripe or PayPal. You don’t need to worry about chargebacks or account freezes. This is commerce on your terms.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, deploy your store, load your first three products, and test the entire flow. Start by forking the COREMERCH GitHub repository and customizing the template with your branding and product details. Integrate NOWPayments and test a transaction end-to-end. Once confirmed, share your store link with your audience via social media or email. Monitor your Google Sheets dashboard for new orders and ensure file delivery is working smoothly. If you encounter issues, refer to the COREMERCH documentation or contact support. By tomorrow, you’ll have a fully operational store that accepts crypto payments globally. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a permanent solution. You’re not just selling products; you’re building infrastructure that cannot be taken away.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Fork the COREMERCH GitHub repository and customize the template with your branding and product details.
2. Set up a NOWPayments account and choose a stablecoin like USDT on the BSC network for low fees.
3. Integrate the NOWPayments widget into your store using the provided code snippet.
4. Test the payment flow with a small transaction to ensure order logging and file delivery work.
5. Load your first three products into Google Sheets and link them to Google Drive for delivery.
6. Share your GitHub Pages store link with your audience via social media or email.
7. Monitor your Google Sheets dashboard for new orders and ensure file delivery is working smoothly.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The COREMERCH blueprints provide step-by-step instructions. You don’t need coding skills—just follow the guide. The stack is designed for creators, not developers.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. We recommend stablecoins like USDT or USDC on BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to manage servers?
No. The stack uses GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic. There are no servers to manage or maintain.
What happens if a payment fails?
NOWPayments automatically retries failed payments. If the transaction doesn’t confirm on-chain, no files are delivered, and no order is logged.
Can I add more products later?
Yes. The stack is scalable. Add new products to your Google Sheets inventory, and they’ll automatically appear in your store.
